name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard Terms for a mutual NDA that lets both parties share confidential information for an agreed purpose while restricting its use and disclosure. Used together with the Mutual NDA Cover Page.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover Page for the Mutual NDA where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality term, governing law, jurisdiction and signatures. Incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard Terms for selling and buying access to a cloud (SaaS) product, covering access and use, restrictions, fees, data, confidentiality, warranties, liability, indemnification and termination. Used with an Order Form.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard Terms setting uptime and support response-time targets for a cloud service, how uptime is calculated, and the service credits or termination rights available when targets are missed. Supplements a Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard Terms governing how a provider processes customer personal data as a processor or subprocessor, including security, subprocessors, data subject requests, breach notification and international transfers under GDPR and UK law.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Standard Terms for an early-access program where a partner gets early access to a product and gives feedback to the provider, covering program participation, feedback ownership, confidentiality and term.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard Terms for engaging a provider to perform services and produce deliverables under one or more Statements of Work, covering fees, intellectual property, confidentiality, warranties, liability and termination.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard Terms for a business partnership in which each party performs the obligations set out in the Cover Page, covering payment, a trademark license, privacy, escalation, confidentiality, liability and termination.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Standard Terms required under HIPAA when a provider creates, receives, maintains or transmits protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity, covering permitted uses, safeguards, breach reporting and return of PHI.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard Terms for licensing software that the customer installs and runs on its own systems, covering the license grant, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, liability, indemnification and termination. Used with an Order Form.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Standard Terms for a short-term trial or evaluation that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a full commercial agreement, with limited scope and easy termination.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a commercial agreement covering the provider's AI services, including rights in customer input and generated output, restrictions on training models with customer data, and related disclaimers.
